questions.questionText: What is the 5th term of the arithmetic sequence 2, 6, 10, 14, ...?
questions.hint: Find the common difference by subtracting consecutive terms.
questions.explanation: The common difference is 6 - 2 = 4. The 5th term = 14 + 4 = 18.

questions.questionText: If geometric mean of two numbers is 6, what could the numbers be?
questions.hint: Geometric mean of a and b = √(ab).
questions.explanation: √(ab) = 6, so ab = 36. Factors of 36: 4×9 = 36 gives GM = √36 = 6.
